Trinity S³AI

Course deck: a t27 course, module by module, widget by widget

Any free t27.ai course in one embed: nine module tabs, three lesson cards each, every card running that lesson's own widget, loaded only as you reach it.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • The course specs specs/course/*.t27 and their Russian bundles, read by scripts/course-from-spec.mjs and written beside this page as courses/<course>.json by scripts/course-pages.mjs
  • The frame budget and the load margins of specs/view/course-view.t27, held equal to the K_ numbers here by scripts/course-view-from-spec.mjs
